  @Then("following job positions should be displayed")
    public void verify_job_positions(io.cucumber.datatable.DataTable dataTable) {

        List<String> expectedJobs = dataTable.asList();
        List<String> actualJobs = careersPage.getVisibleJobTitles();

        for (String expectedJob : expectedJobs) {
            Assert.assertTrue(
                    actualJobs.contains(expectedJob),
                    "❌ Job NOT found: " + expectedJob
            );
        }
    }

	public List<String> getAccountsSectionsList() {

		List<String> accountsList = new ArrayList<>();
		List<WebElement> accountsHeaderList = driver.findElements(accountSections);

		for (WebElement e : accountsHeaderList) {
			String text = e.getText();
			System.out.println(text);
			accountsList.add(text);
		}

		return accountsList;

	}

Locator jobs = page.locator("h3.job-title");
int count = jobs.count();

List<String> jobTitles = new ArrayList<>();

for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    String text = jobs.nth(i).innerText().trim();
    jobTitles.add(text);
    System.out.println(text);
}
